title: Exolon — original ZX Spectrum graphics

loading.notes: The original loading asset is preserved byte for byte. The menu renderer masks baked background stars at user request while retaining planet rectangles, exact source-logo bits and bottom credits. The code in this snapshot has a different address layout from the recovered TAP. Only its screen bytes are used. The assembled exmenu7991.sna snapshots contain blank screens.

messages.encoding: Original xMSG bytecode decoded into 8x8 bitmap cells and full attribute bytes. Recursive font changes persist; E7 SPACE temporarily selects FNT_MAIN.
messages.notes: Loading uses the original SCR with baked background stars masked at display time. Scores use the original bitmap composition plus dynamically rendered source-font names and scores, with animated menu flares outside the scrolling text strip. Bonus uses its source message composition and an original-font cursor. Other extracted messages are data assets; exact original navigation and every transition are not claimed.

animatedTiles.radar: Static FNT_WhiteDish glyphs from the original map block; no added radar animation.

mine.condition: Fired/inactive mines alternate the two horizontal glyph pairs each game tick.

turret.timing: The existing simulation phase changes from 1 to 9 on firing, then decrements to 1. Phase 9 retains the extended barrel; phase 8 retracts it, and phases 7..1 restore it. Pausing simulation freezes the barrel.

rendering.appliesTo: Retro. Optional Remastered is a separate 1024x768 vector presentation using the same logical coordinates and model; it does not replace or modify these original graphics assets.
rendering.resolution: 256x192, with a 256x176 playfield and a 16-pixel HUD
rendering.cells: 8x8 bitmap plus original INK/PAPER/BRIGHT/FLASH attribute byte
rendering.palette: Spectrum color indices map to RGB channel levels 205 and 255; this is a digital presentation, not measured analog video.
rendering.sprites: Original frame bytes, integer coordinates, XOR composition, horizontal player mirroring and source foreground-overlap flags.
rendering.scaling: Pixel-preserving Canvas scaling; image smoothing disabled; no visual interpolation between simulation ticks.
rendering.browserUi: Start, scores, music, volume, pause and touch controls are browser controls outside/below the bitmap canvas.

rights.originalGameGraphics: Original commercial-game bitmap, font and sprite authorship remains with the original rights holders. Distribution of an archival copy does not itself establish a new license.
rights.disassemblyAndDerivedImplementation: The disassembly is credited to Sergey Erokhin (ESL), CC BY-SA 3.0. Source-derived recovery and decoding retain attribution and share-alike notices. This does not relicense the original commercial artwork.
rights.repositoryLicense: The repository license does not replace the original game or archival-media rights.

limitations: This is a native JavaScript reconstruction, not a Z80/ROM emulator or cycle-exact hardware reproduction.
The simulation runs at 30 cycles per second; the original loop duration is variable.
Visual colors and particle directions use a deterministic hash of game tick and object/event data. They do not emulate the Spectrum refresh register R or guarantee the original random sequence.
Source frames and attribute formulas are preserved; exact timing, sprite overlap and phase-by-phase equality with a recording remain unverified.

The loading SCR remains an unchanged static asset. At user request, baked loading-image stars are masked at display time and original menu star sprites animate in empty title and score-background cells. Browser timing/placement and original menu navigation are adaptations.

Score text uses source font pixels, but browser timing and the PLAYER record behavior are adaptations; the Hall of Fame name slot now accepts an eight-character nickname through the browser input, and the fifty highest records are persisted as a named leaderboard in localStorage after confirmation.
Pixel graphics do not establish full original-gameplay fidelity. Some interactions and particles require further comparison; complete physical traversal of all 125 screens remains unverified.
Music arrangements and gamepad/browser controls are separate adaptations documented in README.md and audio/provenance.json.

gameplayStarfield.placement: Only cells with a zero attribute in the saved initial scenery attributes (ATTR_TABLE_COPY) accept a star. Attempts may repeat positions or hit occupied cells, so 66 visible stars are not guaranteed.
gameplayStarfield.randomness: The browser uses deterministic per-screen visual randomness, not the hardware R sequence. This static gameplay starfield is separate from both the original loading SCR and animated text-menu stars.

objectDestruction.motion: Original constant delta set, with a retry for dy if both deltas are zero; no gravity or rotation.

mineExplosion.composition: Five rounds x two space cells x two particle allocations; the source comment saying 10 particles is inconsistent with the executed code. The shared 100-piece capacity still applies.
mineExplosion.position: Two neighboring cells at event.y - 8, with the source floor attribute from the row below the mine.

particles.randomness: Allocation and source raster shapes follow the reconstructed rules; directions use deterministic visual randomness and are not claimed to match original register R values.

titleAnimation.placement: Deterministic per-slot traversal of original empty 2x2 character regions; x aligned to 16 pixels and y to 8, y <= 168. Source artwork is protected. Slot overlap uses XOR.
titleAnimation.adaptation: The original text-menu flares appear on the title and records at user request. The loading SCR asset is unchanged; its baked stars are masked in the displayed background. The score text strip x=64..191, y=56..191 is reserved against star placement. Staggered browser clocks and deterministic placement do not reproduce hardware timing or the R register.
